d:
After 13 years of waiting, Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) is finally here! But GTA 6 is much more than a video game. From the neon-lit streets of Vice City to the bizarre world of Florida Man, Rockstar Games has created a fictional world inspired by real-life America.
In this video, we explore everything about GTA 6 — its story, protagonists Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, the fictional state of Leonida, and the locations that draw inspiration from real places like Miami, the Florida Keys and the Everglades.
